planSteps.description: Navigate to the app home page (environment base URL)
Click the EES link in the navigation (data-testid=nav-ees)
Enter 90 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used)
The traveller days (data-testid=ees-traveller-days) show 64 and the figure gap (data-testid=ees-figure-gap) says the counts are 26 days apart
